settings.title: Actions
settings.description: Choose which actions Hay.chat must ask a person about before it runs them in your store.

approval.title: Approval before actions run
approval.description: When an action needs approval, Hay.chat tells the customer it has requested it and waits. A person approves or declines it from the conversation or the Inbox.
approval.master: Ask a person before these actions run
approval.masterOffHint: Approval is off. Hay.chat runs every action straight away, except those a playbook asks approval for.
approval.unclassifiedNote: Actions from integrations that do not say what they do always need approval while approval is on.

threshold.label: Auto-approve refunds and discounts up to
threshold.help: In the order's currency. Refunds and discounts at or below this amount run without approval. 0 means every one needs approval. Cancellations always need approval while they are switched on.

confirmation.title: Customer confirmation
confirmation.description: Before an action, Hay.chat tells the customer exactly what it will do and asks "Shall I go ahead?". It only continues after the customer replies.
confirmation.label: Ask the customer to confirm first
confirmation.cancelNote: Always on for cancellations, even when this is switched off.

approvers.title: Who can approve
approvers.description: The owner can always approve. Choose which other roles can approve or decline actions.

settings.ownerOnly: Only the organization owner can switch approval off, raise the auto-approve amount or change who approves. You can still switch approval on.

typedConfirm.title: Switch approval off?
typedConfirm.description: These actions will run without anyone seeing them first: {list}.

playbook.title: Approval in this playbook
playbook.description: While this playbook is active, these actions always wait for a person, even under the auto-approve amount or when approval is off in Settings > Actions. A playbook can only add approval, never remove it.
playbook.orgRequired: Already needs approval in Settings > Actions
